CustomField.description: JSON wrapper persisted by the page section editor: { formSelectionMode, object, formQualifiedApiName, formJsonConfig }. It records whether the section sources its layout from a selected Form Component (component mode) or an inline form-builder config (custom mode), keeping both so the admin can toggle modes losslessly. Read by the editor and passed to the runtime form components as form-j-s-o-n; legacy raw form-builder JSON is treated as custom mode. System-managed by the configurator.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stores this section's component configuration, including whether it uses a selected Form or an inline custom form layout. It is written automatically by the page section configurator; edit the section through the Customize panel rather than this field.
CustomField.label: FormConfigJSON
